office_does: The treasurer collects property taxes, receives and pays out county and district money and invests idle funds. Nonpartisan, four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Rhonda Pederson, Treasurer since 2015, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: San Juan County Treasurer since 2015 with 26 years at the county; the only candidate.
highlights: Treasurer since 2015; seven years as chief accountant [S1]
Added autopay and multi-property online payment [S1]
